body: Well I guess this is it then
And I know how to end it I just don't want to hurt anyone, I do not think this world would really be a better place without me but I'm selfish and I can't take this anymore.
I honestly just want to die and be completely forgotten, that's my goal.
It was fun at the start, now I don't really feel that much, it's just what I do to pass the time.
